en.label: Help:
steps: Choose Sign in on Booth's row
Sign in to Booth in the window that opens

en.title: “Not signed in to Booth”
en.body: Or “session expired”. Here's the fix, in three steps.

en.title: A dot on Menu
en.body: Hoard can't read Booth until you sign in again. Nothing in your library is lost.

en.title: Booth ended the sign-in
en.body: Stores do that from time to time. In Menu, Stores says so on Booth's row.

en.title: Choose Sign in
en.body: It's on Booth's row, in Stores.

en.title: Sign in to Booth
en.body: In the window that opens, sign in as you would in your usual browser.
en.note: Hoard keeps the sign-in on this computer.

en.title: Choose Refresh
en.body: Booth's row then says when it was read, and Sync works again.

en.title: Create a support report
en.body: In Settings, choose Create support report, then open an issue on GitHub and attach it.
en.linkNote: More help: the wiki's Troubleshooting page
